name: generate-content-200
notes: End to end through the real Gemini wire client: the handler translates the Gemini-native body to the canonical request, the test engine calls provider.NewClient pointed at the mock upstream (Gemini wire), and the mock replays recorded_response.body. The test also asserts the mock saw POST /models/mock-gemini-model:generateContent with the translated contents and generationConfig. No live provider is involved; all prices are unknown and none are asserted.
